answer: Divide graders into disjoint shards: each answer goes to a panel drawn from one shard, and no grader reviews two answers from the same wallet. An honest agent convinces one panel, but a sybil operator must corrupt a majority in every shard its clones land in, crossing a canyon of checks. When clones reuse phrasing or wander into the same reasoning, panels cross-check fingerprints, and a match sends a ripple of flags to other shards. Each clone adds a panel to bribe and a detection chance, so ten fakes cost ten times more while the reward per fake vote stays flat.
